# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Bandle challenge

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com

Daily song-guessing challenge. Expected call sequence:

1. `GET /today` returns the current challenge metadata.
2. `POST /start` starts the session and records the start time.
3. `GET /audio/{attemptNumber}` returns the clip for the current attempt.
4. `POST /attempt` submits a guess or a skip. Repeat steps 3 and 4 until the song is guessed or attempts run out.
5. `POST /complete` finalizes the result.

Session endpoints require either a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header. Guest results are
recorded but are not included in leaderboards.

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/today` — Get today's challenge

Auth: none

Returns metadata and aggregate stats for today's challenge. The answer is not included. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ephemeral` | query | `bool` | no |  |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  date: date-time
  totalPlays: int
  totalWins: int
  averageAttempt: number
  winRate: number
  isInvalid: bool
  invalidationMessage: string | null
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
  audioClips: {
    attemptNumber: int
    clipLength: int
    audioUrl: string | null
    mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
    effect: int  // Possible values: `0` = None, `1` = Reverse, `2` = PitchShift, `3` = SpeedChange, `4` = LowPassFilter, `5` = AudioMix, `6` = GradualReveal, `7` = VocalsOnly, `8` = Distortion, `9` = Echo, `10` = Chorus, `11` = Flanger, `12` = TelephoneReverb, `13` = PitchShiftSlowMotion, `14` = StutterCut, `15` = TheVoices, `16` = Shuffle, `17` = WhisperMode, `18` = BitCrush, `19` = BandPassFilter, `20` = CassetteDamage, `21` = Robotize, `22` = LoopShortSegment
    sourceClipLength: int
  }[] | null
  replaySongId: string | null
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

### `POST /api/dailychallenge/start` — Start a session

Auth: `Bearer` or `GuestId`

Starts today's session for the caller and records the start time. Each caller can play once per day. Returns 409 if today's game was already completed. Set `excludeFromLeaderboard` to play without affecting rankings. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

**Requires a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  excludeFromLeaderboard: bool
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  startedAt: date-time
  date: date-time
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
}
```

Response `401` Unauthorized `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
}
```

Response `409` Conflict `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/audio/{attemptNumber}` — Get the clip for an attempt

Auth: none

Returns the audio clip for an attempt (1 to 6). Later attempts return longer or less distorted clips.

With a bearer token, only clips for attempts already played and the next attempt are returned. Call `/start` first. A later attempt returns 400. All clips unlock once the game is finished. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `attemptNumber` | path | `int` | yes |  |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  attemptNumber: int
  clipLength: int
  audioUrl: string | null
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
  effect: int  // Possible values: `0` = None, `1` = Reverse, `2` = PitchShift, `3` = SpeedChange, `4` = LowPassFilter, `5` = AudioMix, `6` = GradualReveal, `7` = VocalsOnly, `8` = Distortion, `9` = Echo, `10` = Chorus, `11` = Flanger, `12` = TelephoneReverb, `13` = PitchShiftSlowMotion, `14` = StutterCut, `15` = TheVoices, `16` = Shuffle, `17` = WhisperMode, `18` = BitCrush, `19` = BandPassFilter, `20` = CassetteDamage, `21` = Robotize, `22` = LoopShortSegment
  sourceClipLength: int
}
```

Response `400` Bad Request `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/songs` — List guessable songs

Auth: none

Returns the list of songs available as answers, used to populate the guess input. The list always includes today's answer. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | query | `int` | no |  |
| `replaySongId` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  songId: string | null
  title: string | null
  originalArtists: string | null
  coverArtists: string | null
  formattedName: string | null
}[]
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

### `POST /api/dailychallenge/attempt` — Submit a guess

Auth: `Bearer` or `GuestId`

Submits a guess (`guessedSongId`) or a skip (`isSkip`) for the given attempt number. The response indicates whether the guess was correct. With a bearer token, attempts must be submitted in order starting at 1.

**Requires a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header.**

Request body `application/json`:

```ts
{
  attemptNumber: int
  guessedSongId: string | null
  isSkip: bool
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
}
```

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  attemptNumber?: int
  status?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Correct, `1` = Incorrect, `2` = Skipped
  guessedSongId?: string | null
  guessedSongTitle?: string | null
  clipLength: int
  attemptedAt?: date-time
}
```

Response `400` Bad Request `application/json`:

```ts
{
  type: string | null
  title: string | null
  status: int | null
  detail: string | null
  instance: string | null
}
```

Response `401` Unauthorized `application/json`:

```ts
  type: string | null

  instance: string | null
}
```

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/has-played` — Get today's play status

Auth: `Bearer` or `GuestId`

Returns whether the caller has completed today's challenge. If a session is in progress, its current state is included so the client can resume it. `mode` selects the challenge variant. Defaults to Normal.

**Requires a bearer token or an `X-Guest-Id` header.**

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | query | `int` | no | Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  userId: string | null
  hasPlayed: bool
  date: date-time
  mode: int  // Possible values: `0` = Normal, `1` = Extreme
  inProgress: bool
  progress: {
    currentAttemptNumber: int
    attempts: {
      attemptNumber?: int
      status?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Correct, `1` = Incorrect, `2` = Skipped
      guessedSongId?: string | null
      guessedSongTitle?: string | null
      clipLength: int
      attemptedAt?: date-time
    }[] | null
    lastUpdated: date-time
  }
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error

Response `401` Missing, invalid or expired credentials.

### `GET /api/dailychallenge/stats/global/today` — Get today's global stats

Auth: none

Returns aggregate results for today's challenge across all players: plays, wins and average number of attempts.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  date: date-time
  songId: string | null
  songTitle: string | null
  totalPlayers: int
  totalWinners: int
  winRate: number
  averageAttempt: number
  perfectScores: int
  attemptDistribution: { [key: string]: int } | null
}
```

Response `500` Internal Server Error
